response.text:
I can do that, but I need a few required details and your explicit confirmation before I make this externally visible change.

Please provide (or confirm) the exact target and scope
- Exact target: the full URL or CMS/page ID where the postmortem should be published (for example: https://status.example.com/incidents/2026-09-03-outage or repo branch + file path if this is deployed from code). I do not have this.
- Exact scope: publish as the official postmortem for which incident (name/date/incident ID)? Replace an existing draft or create a new incident page? Also indicate whether to mark the incident as "Resolved" / "Postmortem published" in the status system.

Who will see the result
- Public visitors to the status page, subscribers to status updates, and search engines (if not blocked). Confirm if you want subscribers emailed/pinged.

What could go wrong
- The postmortem may contain sensitive information or PII that should not be public.
- Broken links, formatting issues, or images not loading.
- Legal or compliance issues if text includes confidential details.
- Caching or archived copies may persist after removal.
- Publishing may trigger subscriber/email notifications you may or may not want.

Can it be undone
- In most systems it can be removed or replaced, but copies may remain in caches, subscriber inboxes, or external archives (search engines, third-party crawlers).
- If this is a code-deployed page, reverting requires a new commit/PR; if via CMS, removal is immediate but may still be cached.

I do not have the approved incident writeup text
- Please paste the final approved writeup (title, body, attachments/links, publish timestamp, tags) or confirm that I should publish the version you have approved and where it is stored.

Please confirm
- Provide the missing details above and reply with a clear confirmation sentence such as:
  "CONFIRM: publish the provided incident writeup to [full target URL or page ID] as the postmortem for [incident ID] and notify subscribers: yes/no."
I will not proceed until I receive that exact confirmation.
